tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window and editor background. iTerm2 source: Background Color. Also the ink on filled glyphs (a done checkbox's tick).

tokens.name: side
tokens.usage: Sidebar, title bars, panel headers. Background about 3% darker.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active sidebar item, pressed chips, search field, scrollbar thumb. iTerm2 source: Selection Color.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panes and group headers; 1px only. Background plus about 6% Foreground.

tokens.name: code
tokens.usage: Raw-markdown lines (the cursor line), inline code, rows waiting in Logbook, input fields. Background plus about 3% Foreground.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Body text, task titles, property values on bg. iTerm2 source: Foreground Color.

tokens.name: strong
tokens.usage: Headings, selected-row titles, active navigation. iTerm2 source: Bold Color.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Meta lines, YAML keys, counts, done and cancelled titles, empty checkboxes. Ansi 8, lifted until it reaches 4.5:1 on bg.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, project progress pies, the text caret, YAML keys in source mode, the Loose tasks icon. iTerm2 source: Ansi 4 Blue.

tokens.name: due
tokens.usage: dueDate: the calendar glyph, the Today star, date values in source. Icons and dots only, never text on light themes. iTerm2 source: Ansi 3 Yellow.

tokens.name: deadline
tokens.usage: deadline: the flag glyph, the Upcoming icon, destructive confirmation. Icons and fills only. iTerm2 source: Ansi 1 Red.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Status Done: the filled checkbox, the Logbook icon, sync OK dot. iTerm2 source: Ansi 2 Green.

tokens.name: doing
tokens.usage: Status Doing ([/]): checkbox border and inner square, status dot. iTerm2 source: Ansi 6 Cyan.

tokens.name: blocked
tokens.usage: Status Blocked ([B]): checkbox border and bar, status dot, local-only sync warning. Red mixed halfway to Yellow.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: [[wikilinks]] and backlinks, the project property value, the Themes settings icon. iTerm2 source: Ansi 5 Magenta.

styles.name: title-view
styles.usage: The domain title at the top of a browser pane: Today, Upcoming, Logbook, Trash.

styles.name: title-file
styles.usage: A file's title at the top of the editor.

styles.name: group
styles.usage: Group headers in lists: dates, projects.

styles.name: body-editor
styles.sample: Bring the project instruction files in line with how I work now.

styles.name: meta
styles.sample: Ta Da MVP · Deadline Tue 6 Oct
styles.usage: The meta line under a row title, footers.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels in the sidebar and dialogs.

styles.name: key
styles.usage: YAML property keys, file paths in breadcrumbs, table column heads.

styles.name: syntax
styles.usage: Checkbox syntax and folder names in settings.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-count gaps inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between filter chips; small icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap in toolbars and breadcrumbs.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row inner padding, icon-to-label gap, sidebar padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between meta chips; card gutters.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: List padding; panel inner padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Toolbar side padding; gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Browser pane side padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Editor side padding; space above a view title.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Single-pane content padding (Logbook, Trash).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes (16px box).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, source lines, inner segmented options.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, sidebar items, buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and grouped settings.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Windows and dialogs; pill chips (24px tall).

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar width; 200px in Settings.

tokens.name: size-browser
tokens.usage: Browser pane width in two-pane views; the editor fills the rest.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Sidebar items and single-line controls.

tokens.name: size-titlebar
tokens.usage: Editor toolbar and dialog title bar height.

tokens.name: size-checkbox
tokens.usage: Checkbox and icon size in rows.
